    About

    I’m a Senior Applied Scientist at Amazon Prime Video where I’m part of the Playback Intelligence Team. I’m interested in leveraging Applied ML/AI and Optimization techniques for problems in Internet Video including Adaptive Streaming, Content Delivery and Observational / Operational Analytics. I received my PhD from USC where I was advised by Ramesh Govindan.

    I’m also an Adjunct Assistant Professor at the Computer Science Department at NCSU where I contribute to work on emergent Multimedia applications.
